question: What will be the closing value of Meta Platforms (META) stock (META on Yahoo Finance) on September 10, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of META on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-10. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
baseline:
Computed by code from Yahoo Finance daily closes for META: latest close 578.8500 on 2026-08-12.
Target date 2026-09-10 is 20 trading observations ahead. Percentiles of the price on the target date,
from the empirical distribution of 20-observation returns over the last 3 years (last year weighted double):
p5: 495.5526, p10: 514.8709, p25: 550.128, p50: 585.5026, p75: 622.2881, p90: 654.1728, p95: 678.2754
This ignores news and known events; adjust for them. Check the symbol matches the resolution source
(exchange, contract month, close vs settlement price).
research:
Meta closed at **$578.85 on 2026-08-12**, the latest close available before the cutoff. That is 20 trading days before the target date, and nothing so far settles the question. The stock is about 3% below the historical median of the 20-day baseline, after an earnings selloff and a partial rebound.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-12: The Yahoo Finance META history page shows open 601.07, high 604.50, low 578.21, close **578.85**, volume about 16.2M. The prior close on 2026-08-11 was 599.12, so the stock fell about 3.4%. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/META/history)
- Ticker check: the question uses META (Nasdaq) on Yahoo Finance, the same series as the baseline. 2026-09-10 is a Thursday and a trading day.

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened that settles or nearly settles the question.
- At $578.85 the stock sits at about the 47th percentile of the baseline distribution (p50 is $585.50).

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-12: Meta fell about 3.2% intraday, to roughly $579.77, while the communication services sector lost about 0.8%. The report blamed technical, momentum-driven selling. It also mentioned a criminal complaint by a German digital rights group over privacy in Ray-Ban Meta glasses. [Sahm Capital](https://www.sahmcapital.com/news/content/whats-going-on-with-the-drop-in-meta-stock-2026-08-12)
- 2026-08-03: The stock rose nearly 7% as investors returned to megacap tech after the post-earnings selloff. [cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/meta-stock-falls-5-as-capex-outlook-climbs-to-145-billion/), [leverageshares](https://leverageshares.com/en-eu/insights/meta-q2-2026-earnings-ai-capex-turns-market-sentiment/)
- 2026-07-31: One page says the stock closed July 31 near $557. I could not confirm that figure. [Polymarket mirror](https://polymarkets.co.il/sw/market/meta-week-august-7-2026/)
- 2026-07-30: UBS cut its price target to $715 and Baird to $750. [Benzinga](https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/META/price-targets)
- 2026-07-30: The stock fell about 8% after the Q2 report, following an after-hours drop of roughly 10-11%. [Stocktwits](https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/meta-stock-tumbles-11-after-hours-soaring-ai-costs-squeeze-profits-and-soft-q3-outlook-disappoints/cZNTe7URJT8)
- 2026-07-29: Meta reported Q2 results:
  - Revenue was about $60.8B, a beat.
  - Earnings per share were $6.18, against expectations of about $7.13-7.19, a miss.
  - Q3 revenue guidance was $61-64B, against a $63.24B consensus.
  - Full-year 2026 expense guidance rose to $165-169B.
  - Capex guidance was narrowed to $130-145B, raising the bottom from $125B.
  - Q2 costs included $2.4B in legal charges and $1.18B in severance. Q2 capex of about $31.1B used roughly 98% of operating cash flow.
  
  [Stocktwits](https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/default/equity/meta-stock-tumbles-11-after-hours-soaring-ai-costs-squeeze-profits-and-soft-q3-outlook-disappoints/cZNTe7URJT8), [indmoney](https://www.indmoney.com/blog/us-stocks/why-meta-stock-fell-q2-earnings-analysis), [leverageshares](https://leverageshares.com/en-eu/insights/meta-q2-2026-earnings-ai-capex-turns-market-sentiment/)

### 4. Base rates
- 2026-08-12: The code-computed 20-trading-day distribution from the last 3 years, with the last year weighted double, gives these target-date prices: p5 $495.55, p10 $514.87, p25 $550.13, p50 $585.50, p75 $622.29, p90 $654.17, p95 $678.28.
- That puts the middle 50% at about -5% to +7.5%, and the 90% range at about -14% to +17%.
- Recent realized volatility is high:
  - About -8% on 2026-07-30.
  - About +7% on 2026-08-03.
  - -3.4% on 2026-08-12.
  - The rebound from roughly $557 to $599 took about 8 sessions.
- No earnings report falls inside the window, which usually means lower volatility than the earnings-inclusive history the baseline draws on.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs daily and monthly "META close above $X" markets for August 2026. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/meta-above-in-august-2026) I found no market for 2026-09-10 and no usable odds from before the cutoff. The mirror sites showed inconsistent snapshots I could not date.
- About 2026-08: The analyst consensus target was about $768.58 from 57 analysts, with a range of $580 to $1,000, mostly Buy ratings. [Walnut Invest](https://walnutinvest.com/stocks/meta/forecast) MarketBeat's average was $835.64 as of 2026-07-22, rated "moderate buy". [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/META/forecast/) These are 12-month targets and say little about a 4-week move.

### 6. Upcoming events before 2026-09-10
I did not confirm any of these dates in sources:
- Late August: Nvidia earnings, which tend to move sentiment on AI capex.
- Around 2026-09-04: US August jobs report.
- 2026-09-07: Labor Day market holiday.
- Around 2026-09-10 to 09-11: August CPI, possibly after the target close.
- The FOMC meeting likely falls after 09-10.
- Meta Connect is usually mid-to-late September, probably after resolution.
- Company-specific risks:
  - Legal and regulatory charges, including the teen-safety cases and EU or German privacy complaints.
  - Any financing or debt news tied to the capex plan.
  - Sector rotation in megacap AI stocks.
